people.imagined: Spring levy morning on the lake shore. He has just finished calling the file to halt, and the whole plain of farmers is standing still behind him. A wild goose flies low over the water and he follows it with his eyes only. He has the old banner on his shoulder because the head always carries it at the levy.
people.subject: The moment: at the spring levy on a lake shore at first light, he stands square to the viewer with a long grey banner resting on his right shoulder, his eyes following something in the sky just past the viewer's left. Face: a broad square weathered face, the jaw a hard rectangle; skin brown and windburnt with deep lines running from nose to mouth corners; a short grey-flecked beard cut flat along the jaw; heavy straight brows; small dark eyes, calm and patient, a little cold; a thick nose, a wide flat mouth that does not smile. Hair: iron-grey, pulled up under a round grey felt cap. A single long grey goose feather stands upright in the cap at the left, the biggest thing at the top of the picture. Body: broad, square-shouldered and solid, planted and still. Clothing: a short-skirted marching coat of fine grey-brown felt, close and well fitted, with a high standing collar and narrow sleeves; under it a pale undyed hemp shirt, with a band of damp-looking hemp cloth sewn inside the collar; across the chest a wide plain leather strap; no jewellery. Hands and objects: his right hand holds up the banner pole; the banner is a long grey felt strip pieced from bands of many slightly different greys, with one small goose stitched in undyed wool near the top, unmarked by any writing; his left hand hangs open and flat at his side. Background: a pale lake with flat grey light and a long blurred line of standing figures in grey-brown on the far shore. Light: cool flat dawn light from the upper left, the feather catching a thin edge of warm light. Expression: a still, patient, level look, the small dark eyes calm and a little cold and the wide flat mouth shut, a commander with the whole plain waiting on him. A faint dull yellow-brown earth tint in the air.

people.imagined: Late afternoon on a levy day. He has been drumming and shouting since dawn and has stopped to drink from a cask with the drum resting against his hip. He is laughing at a farmer who dropped his shield. The wine is making him red.
people.subject: The moment: late in the levy day on the lake shore, head thrown back in a big laugh, a wine ladle halfway to his mouth. Face: a huge round red-brown face, wide cheeks flushed with wine; a big broken-looking nose; thick black brows with grey in them; small bright eyes crinkled nearly shut; a wide open mouth showing square yellow teeth; a short bristling grey stubble beard. Hair: thick grey hair cropped short like a farmer's, no cap, a few strands stuck to his sweating forehead. Body: enormous, deep-chested and thick-necked, a farmer-built man filling the width of the frame. Clothing: a grey-brown felt coat of fine cloth cut short for marching, the collar open at the throat, the sleeves pushed to the elbow over thick hairy forearms; a wide leather belt through which a long wooden drumstick is thrust, its head visible at his hip beside the grey felt skirt. A small grey goose feather is pinned to a strap on his left shoulder, since he has taken his cap off and hooked it on the belt. Hands and objects: the right hand lifts a long wooden ladle of dark wine; the left rests on the taut yellowish buffalo-hide head of a big drum with a dark elm frame, which fills the lower right corner. Background: blurred lake shore, rows of spears planted upright in the mud, orange late sun low behind. Light: warm low gold light from the upper left, flushing his cheeks. Expression: roaring laughter that has something hard under it. Earth-yellow warmth, a faint watery blue in the shadows.

people.imagined: Night on a ruined watch platform. She is alone between drills, a short sword on her back, tying her braid again. She has just looked up because she heard someone step on the stair and is deciding whether to be caught.
people.subject: The moment: at night on a stone platform, one hand pulling her braid over her shoulder, her face turned sharply toward a sound on the stairs, ready to bolt or to stand. Face: a long face with a strong square jaw, her father's; skin tanned brown, a few freckles across the nose; straight dark brows drawn down; large dark eyes alert and bright; a firm mouth with the lower lip caught between her teeth; no scars. Hair: black, in one thick braid over the left shoulder, a grey goose feather woven into it, the feather large and clearly visible. Body: tall, rangy and long-necked, narrow-hipped, a fighter's straight back. Clothing: a heavy coat of thick grey-brown felt, the point's coat, too short in the sleeve and clearly cut down several times, with a stand collar buttoned to the chin; a plain pale hemp shirt beneath at the wrists; a narrow leather sling across the chest. Over her right shoulder rises the hilt of a short plain sword worn high on the back, with a bare wrapped grip. No jewellery. Hands and objects: left hand holds the braid; right hand is closed on the sling strap near her collarbone. Background: a dark crumbling parapet, a few stars, a thin line of low far mist; two blurred figures standing in a straight line far behind her. Light: pale blue moonlight from the upper left, with a small cold shine on the sword hilt. Expression: wary, daring, the half grin of someone breaking a rule. A trace of watery blue-green around her hair.

people.imagined: Dusk in the burial rows. He is kneeling among the row markers with his writing board on his lap, pausing between two small marks. He has just wiped his fingers on his sleeve and looked at the dark under his nails, a habit.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk among rows of low stone markers, he has stopped writing and is looking at his own fingertips, which show black under every nail. Face: a thin, plain, bony face, the kind no one remembers; skin sallow; completely bald, the scalp smooth and pale; thin pale eyebrows, almost absent; small pale-brown eyes held down on his hands; a long thin nose; a narrow lipless mouth, the corners turned slightly down; a few deep vertical lines in the forehead. Body: thin, stooped a little, narrow shoulders, long neck. Clothing: a plain grey-brown felt coat of good cloth with a low collar, long sleeves rolled once at the wrist; his head bare, no feather; round his neck a cord of undyed hemp from which hangs, flat against his chest, a rough wooden board with a few blank paper sheets clipped to it, unmarked. Hands and objects: both hands raised before his chest; the fingers are long and narrow, and each of the ten nails is rimmed black, drawn large and clear; a short stub of ink brush is held between two fingers of the right hand. Background: rows of small low grey stones in the grass fading into dusk, and a dark gap between two of them. Light: low dim blue dusk light from the upper left, a thin warm line along his bald head. Expression: a quiet, careful, guarded look, the pale-brown eyes held down on his hands and the narrow mouth closed, a man hiding something small and kind. A faint cool blue-grey, damp, around him.

people.imagined: A break in the levy. She has let the drum fall silent to pour tea from a small kettle and is grinning across the mess line at a farmer who is still standing at attention because nobody told him to stop.
people.subject: The moment: during the levy she has put a drum aside and is pouring tea into a bowl with a wicked grin at someone out of frame. Face: a round tanned cheerful face, wide cheekbones and a snub nose; a gap between her front teeth; thick short brows, one raised; bright dark eyes crinkled at the corners; a smear of drum-skin chalk on her chin; a dimple on the left cheek. Hair: coarse black hair done in a high round knot on top of her head, and a long wooden drumstick pushed through the knot like a pin, its two ends sticking out visibly on both sides. Body: sturdy, short and stocky with strong forearms, easy slouch. Clothing: a grey-brown felt coat, short-skirted, good cloth, with the left sleeve pushed up to the elbow; collar loose; a pale hemp shirt; a narrow brown belt; a small grey feather tucked behind her ear. Hands and objects: the right hand pours steaming tea from a small dented iron kettle into a clay bowl held in the left; her left wrist carries a wrapped band of red cord. Background: the edge of a big drum with pale hide, the lake shore, a row of distant stiff-standing farmers in the haze. Light: warm afternoon light from the upper left, steam bright against the dark. Expression: shameless amusement. A faint earthy yellow-orange warmth about her.

people.imagined: Rest day on the river bank at dusk. He stands in file posture even though he is alone, counting the dark ferries on the far side one at a time. His left leg is locked stiff. He has not blinked in a while.
people.subject: The moment: standing very straight on a river bank at dusk, alone, as if in a line, looking across the water at something on the far shore. Face: a short broad face with a heavy square jaw; skin dark and creased like old leather; heavy brows pulled together, a deep line between them; narrow dark eyes fixed and not moving; a flat broad nose; a long tight mouth, a thin white scar at the left corner; a grey-flecked short beard. Hair: cropped grey hair, thin on top, no cap; a plain grey feather pinned flat against the side of his head. Body: short, heavy and thick-limbed; he stands with his weight entirely on the right leg and the left leg held rigid and straight like a post, the knee never bending; his chin is level. Clothing: a grey-brown felt coat of fine heavy cloth, short-skirted, high collar, hemmed neatly; a hemp shirt; a dark leather belt with a plain iron buckle; the left trouser leg is wrapped from knee to ankle in tight bands of grey cloth. Hands and objects: both hands hang straight at his sides with the thumbs along the seams, the right fist closed. Background: flat reed-green river water, a far shore with a row of tiny dark boat shapes drawn up on the mud, bruised orange sky low. Light: weak orange sunset light from the upper left. Expression: stony, patient, a grief stored very deep. A brown-yellow earth tone in the air.

people.imagined: The evening of the line test. He has stood from dawn to dusk and has just been told he passed. He has not yet understood he can move, and is still standing in exactly the same position with a blank face.
people.subject: The moment: dusk after the line test, he is still standing at attention in the same place, hands at his sides, not yet told he may move. Face: a young farm boy's round smooth face, wide-set eyes wide open and not blinking, gaze fixed straight ahead through the viewer; skin sunburnt red-brown across the nose and cheeks; thick untidy brows; a slightly open mouth, lower lip slack; a long straight nose; ears that stick out. Hair: thick dark hair, cut by hand in a bowl shape, a cowlick at the crown; no cap. Body: tall and thin, a growing boy with big wrists, a rigid, perfectly straight back. Clothing: a new grey-brown felt coat of good cloth, slightly too big at the shoulders, the sleeves covering half the hands; a plain pale hemp shirt, collar buttoned to the neck; a plain cloth belt, tidily knotted. No feather yet; there is a spot of bare cloth where one would go. Hands and objects: arms straight, fingers loosely curled, the knuckles chapped. Background: a dusty empty field in blue dusk, a long line of footprints and a single dropped hat far behind. Light: soft dusk light from the upper left, an orange rim on his cheek. Expression: blank, obedient, uncomprehending. A faint pale green of young wood about him.

people.imagined: A river ford at morning after a swim she was told not to take. She stands knee-deep with her sleeves pushed up, her hair still wet, her fingers pruned. A teacher is somewhere behind her about to scold.
people.subject: The moment: standing knee-deep at a river ford, holding her hands up and looking at her own fingertips, wrinkled and white from the water. Face: a narrow brown face, freckled over the cheeks; wet dark lashes; thin straight brows; big dark river-coloured eyes, shy but amused; a small rounded nose; a small closed mouth with a tiny smile held in; a drop of water running down the jaw. Hair: wet black hair in two plaits that hang heavily over the shoulders, a grey goose feather tied at the end of the left plait. Body: small, slight and wiry, the shoulders narrow. Clothing: a grey-brown felt coat of fine cloth with the skirt tied up out of the water in a knot at the hip; sleeves pushed above the elbows; a pale hemp shirt wet at the collar; a plain cord belt; bare calves in the water. Hands and objects: both hands held up at chest height, palms toward her; the finger pads wrinkled deep as dried plums, drawn plainly. Background: soft green reed banks, a flat brown river with small ripples, a half-sunk flat ferry boat tied up. Light: clear cool morning light from the upper left, bright on the water behind. Expression: guilty, delighted. A faint watery blue shimmer around the hands.

people.imagined: Night in the cooks' storeroom. He has crept in with a lamp covered by his hand and is bent over a sack of millet, head tilted as though listening to it. He has heard footsteps and has frozen, bent.
people.subject: The moment: at night, hunched over a sack in a storeroom with one hand cupped round a small lamp, head tilted to the side as if listening to a well shaft. Face: a pinched narrow pale face; the head tilted sharply left; sunken cheeks; heavy-lidded eyes with dark rings, watchful and dull gold in the lamp; thin dark brows; a long thin nose; a mean small mouth with thin lips; a thin line of stubble on the upper lip. Hair: lank black hair to the ears, a grey feather stuck in it crooked. Body: thin and stooped, the back rounded forward and the neck pushed out ahead of the shoulders; the stoop is the main thing. Clothing: a grey-brown felt coat of fine cloth, correct but worn badly, the collar rumpled; a hemp shirt; a cloth belt with a small pouch that clinks. Hands and objects: the left hand shields a tiny clay oil lamp, lit through the fingers; the right hand grips the neck of a bulging cloth sack of millet, a few grains spilling. Background: dark sacks stacked to the ceiling, a hanging string of dried onions, shadow. Light: a small orange lamp glow from lower right lighting his chin and cheek only; everything else near black. Expression: furtive, counting. A dull yellow-grey pallor.

people.imagined: Midnight on a watch post. She has been standing too long and has begun to bounce on her toes. She is retying her braid for the third time and looking down the dark line toward the point's post, wishing she were there.
people.subject: The moment: standing a night watch, shifting her weight from foot to foot and tying a braid ribbon, her eyes sliding off the front toward something she wants. Face: a freckled round face, slightly sunburnt; quick dark eyes flicking to the side; thin arched brows; a short upturned nose; a mouth that has begun a smile and stopped; a small chipped front tooth. Hair: long dark-brown hair in a loose braid, one thick lock escaping, tied at the end with a strip of green reed; a grey feather pinned over the left ear. Body: wiry, light on her feet, her whole body leaning forward, the left foot lifted. Clothing: a grey-brown felt coat, short-skirted, well fitted but creased from long standing; a pale hemp shirt; leather wristbands; a plain cord belt with a wooden whistle on it. Hands and objects: both hands behind her head holding the braid, elbows wide; a short spear leans against her shoulder, its shaft wrapped with reed strips. Background: a dark palisade, a dim lantern on a pole, a faint line of fog. Light: cold moonlight from the upper left and a pale lantern glow from the right. Expression: eager and restless, caught between duty and a hope. A faint watery blue about her hands.

people.imagined: Morning, in his grandfather's tent. He has just handed over the night's report and the old man has said something pleased. He smiles half a second late, as though he first checked what the smile should be.
people.subject: The moment: in a morning tent, giving a delayed polite smile to someone in front of him, the smile arriving a beat after his eyes. Face: a pleasant, even, handsome face, a little too smooth; skin clean and light brown; neat straight brows; large dark eyes that sit slightly apart from the mouth, steady and watching; a straight nose; a mouth whose smile only reaches the lips, one side higher than the other; a tiny mole on the left jaw. Hair: neat black hair drawn into a tidy topknot with a grey feather pin sitting exactly straight. Body: medium height, straight, well-groomed, with the same broad build as his grandfather but narrower; the shoulders held very even. Clothing: a grey-brown felt coat of the best cloth, perfectly pressed, buttoned high; a pale hemp shirt with a clean collar; a belt of braided grey cord with a tidy knot; the cuffs exactly even. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a folded plain paper packet against his chest; the left hand is open, palm slightly up, a gesture of honesty. Background: a canvas tent wall with a lantern hanging, a half-drunk cup of tea on a stool, soft warm brown shadows. Light: warm lantern light from the upper left, an even glow. Expression: agreeable, practised, slightly too slow. A faint earth-brown tint.

people.imagined: The last grey hour at Chiết Kích Nguyên, as a remembered portrait. He walks backwards at the end of the file with a wet cloth held at his mouth, eyes on the line he is leading out, the grey drifting round his shoulders.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the founder at the age of forty-three, walking backwards out of a grey mist with a wet cloth raised to his mouth and nose. Face: a long hard stone-grey face, deep lines from the nose to the jaw; the cloth covers the mouth and the lower face, leaving the heavy straight brows and narrow dark-ringed eyes, set and stubborn, looking at the line ahead of him; a broad forehead; grey-flecked beard stubble above the cloth. Hair: close-cropped black hair with grey at the temples, a round felt cap with no feather yet. Body: broad, tall and strongly built, shoulders square, one arm out to hold back unseen people behind him. Clothing: a plain levy captain's coat of thick felt, brown-grey, short-skirted, sturdy, with leather straps crossing the chest; a hemp shirt; a plain belt. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a dripping wet hemp cloth against his face; the left arm is stretched out sideways, the palm flat, steadying someone beyond the frame. Background: thick grey fog, the dim shapes of a line of forty men with their hands on each other's shoulders, fading away. Light: dim grey light from the upper left, everything desaturated. Expression: grim and unmoved, a man who will not break. The whole picture is faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, the edges darkened. A dull earth-yellow tint.

people.imagined: A remembered portrait of the second head at the moment she signed the first levy contract with the cities: seated beside a new elm drum, calm, steady, her hand on the drum frame.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the second head as a woman of forty, seated at the lake shore with her palm laid flat on a drum frame, in the quiet before the first levy under her contract. Face: an even oval face with level features; skin pale brown and smooth; straight, evenly shaped dark brows, exactly matched; steady dark eyes looking straight out, calm and a little warm; a straight nose; a firm small mouth with the faintest approving curve; a very faint line at each eye. Hair: black, smooth, parted in the middle and pinned into a low neat knot at the nape, a single grey goose feather in it, perfectly vertical. Body: medium, straight, upright, composed, shoulders level as a ruler. Clothing: a grey-brown felt coat of fine cloth, short-skirted, collar high and crisp; under it a hemp shirt with narrow cuffs; a belt of braided grey cord; a small dark elm leaf pinned at the left collar. Hands and objects: her right palm lies flat on the dark curved frame of a big drum with a taut pale hide head; her left hand rests in her lap, fingers straight. Background: the lake with a long line of farmers in grey-brown, small, evenly spaced, fading in mist. Light: soft light from the upper left. Expression: composed, authoritative, quietly kind. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. A trace of earth yellow.

people.imagined: A remembered portrait of the file leader the morning he took ten men to hold the rope bridge, laughing with his men, banner in hand, not knowing.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of a file leader of seventy-two, grinning broadly at the start of a march, a short grey banner staff on his shoulder. Face: a cheerful broad face with a thick neck; weathered tan skin crinkled by laughter; bushy white-flecked eyebrows; round bright brown eyes; a wide nose; a big gap-toothed grin; a thick grey moustache, and a short grey beard; a small old scar across the chin. Hair: thin grey hair tied back in a short tail, a grey feather stuck through the band at an angle. Body: stout, barrel-chested and thick-armed, a man at ease. Clothing: a sturdy grey-brown felt coat of good cloth with a short skirt; a hemp shirt; a wide leather belt with a plain iron buckle; leather bracers on the forearms. Hands and objects: the right arm round the shoulder of a blurred younger man; the left hand hoists a short banner staff with a small grey felt pennant, unmarked. Background: a rope bridge's two stout posts and slack ropes in misty morning light behind him, and nine blurred men in a file. Light: warm morning light from the upper left. Expression: a warm, joking, sure grin, the round brown eyes bright and crinkled and the gap-toothed mouth wide open, a man who has crossed this bridge many times. The whole picture is faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. A pale earth tint.

people.imagined: Noon drill on the lake shore. He has set his file facing the sun as always and he squints at it while giving the order, the sun full on his lined face, a hand shielding nothing.
people.subject: The moment: giving a drill command at noon, facing straight into the bright sun, his eyes squeezed nearly shut. Face: a lean, hard, long face, burnt dark brown from decades of sun; a deep fan of white lines round each eye from squinting; heavy grey brows pulled together; a hooked nose; a wide stern mouth open on a barked word; a short grey-white beard cropped close. Hair: thin grey hair under a round grey felt cap with one short feather; sun-whitened. Body: lean, upright and straight-backed, narrow-hipped, the posture of a drill-master. Clothing: a grey-brown felt coat of fine cloth, short-skirted, the collar high and the cuffs neat; under it a thin hemp shirt; a belt of black leather; a square plate of dull bronze sewn on the chest. Hands and objects: the right arm thrust out straight to point an order, the fingers together like a blade; in the left hand a short pale staff wrapped with cord. Background: a bright empty sky and the bleached shore; rows of small figures in grey-brown with raised spears, blurred. Light: harsh high white-gold sun from the upper left, strong light on his face and lines. Expression: hard, stern, impatient, longing for a real war. A faint watery blue-green in the shadows.

people.imagined: A caravan road at dawn, as she checks a line of escorts and weighs the picket lots in a cloth bag. She wears the thumb-guard because she never takes it off, and weighs the bag in her palm a moment longer than she needs.
people.subject: The moment: on a caravan road at dawn, weighing a small cloth bag of wooden lots in her palm while her eyes check something past the viewer. Face: a lean narrow face with high cheekbones; light brown skin; level thin brows; sharp grey-brown eyes, assessing and cool; a long straight nose; a neat small mouth with no expression; a faint crease at one corner; a tiny pair of studs in her ears. Hair: black, pulled back hard into a low tight knot, no feather but a small grey felt band around it. Body: slim, straight, upright and exact, narrow shoulders. Clothing: a grey-brown felt coat of fine cloth, closely fitted for marching, a stand collar, narrow sleeves; a hemp shirt; a plain belt with brass studs; on the right thumb a thick leather thumb-guard shaped like a half-cup, the thing that stands out. Hands and objects: the right hand holds up a small drawstring bag of cloth, heavy at the bottom, from which a few smooth wooden lots show; the left hand holds a narrow strap of a long horn bow case across her chest. Background: a dusty road, a line of laden carts with blurred escorts, a grey early sky. Light: cool grey dawn light from the upper left. Expression: neutral, calculating, hard to read. A faint earth-brown tone.

people.imagined: In the mess hall, a first week at the gate. He is telling a bored table, again, whose elbow broke his nose, with his finger pointing at the bump itself.
people.subject: The moment: in a mess hall, pointing proudly at his own crooked nose while telling a story to people across the table. Face: a square youthful face with a crooked nose, the bridge bent hard to the right and flattened, the most visible mark, drawn large; a yellowish fading bruise-shadow along the bridge; a wide eager mouth in a boastful half grin; one brow cocked high; bright brown eyes; a stubbled chin. Hair: short stiff brown hair standing up, a new grey feather stuck in at the front. Body: stocky and big-boned, the shoulders already broad, leaning forward over the table with an elbow among the bowls. Clothing: a grey-brown felt coat of fine cloth, new and a little stiff, the collar open; hemp shirt; a plain cloth belt. Hands and objects: the right forefinger points at the middle of his nose; the left hand holds a small wooden bowl of rice with a spoon standing in it; the knuckles are scabbed. Background: a long wooden mess-hall table crowded with bowls and chopsticks, a blurred row of other grey-brown figures leaning in to listen, a rafter hung with dried gourds, and smoky warm air. Light: warm yellowish lamplight from the upper left. Expression: a cocky, loud, pleased-with-himself grin, one brow cocked high and the bright brown eyes sweeping the table for an audience. A faint yellow earth warmth.

people.imagined: The night drill on the old tower. She holds the wet cloth to her face and breathes once. Then nothing, for far longer than anyone else can bear. The others have already counted twice.
people.subject: The moment: at the night drill, pressing a damp cloth to her mouth and drawing one very slow, deep breath with her eyes closed. Face: an oval pale face, narrow and still; eyes closed, long dark lashes laid flat on the cheeks; smooth straight brows; a small straight nose; the mouth hidden behind the damp cloth; a faint blue tint of cold on the cheeks; a single bead of water on the temple. Hair: long black hair tied at the nape and falling down her back, a grey feather in the tie. Body: slender, quiet and straight-backed, the shoulders relaxed and low, the chest rising in one long slow breath. Clothing: a grey-brown felt coat of fine cloth, tidy and short-skirted, with a high collar; a hemp shirt; a plain cloth belt. Hands and objects: both hands lift a wet grey cloth folded into a square against her nose and mouth; a second figure's hand reaching to take the cloth appears blurred at the edge of the frame. Background: dark old stone walls, a high cold window of stars, a line of blurred standing figures in grey-brown, and a bucket of water on the flags at her feet. Light: faint cold blue moonlight from the upper left, catching the bead of water at her temple. Expression: a complete, patient stillness, the closed eyes smooth and the face given over entirely to the breath. A faint cool watery blue.

people.imagined: Night in the barracks. He sits on his bed holding the long drum case to his chest and glancing at the door. Something rolled inside the case rustles when he shifts. He has not let go of it all day.
people.subject: The moment: at night, sitting up stiffly on a bed and clutching a long drum case against his chest like a child, eyes flicking toward the door. Face: a thin, nervous young face with a pointed chin; fair skin with the sheen of a fisher's boy; dark eyes wide and worried, the whites showing; thin straight brows raised and drawn in; a small tight mouth; a faint line of sweat on the upper lip; fine downy stubble. Hair: dark, short and tousled, a grey feather behind the ear. Body: thin, narrow-chested, hunched round the case, knees drawn up. Clothing: a grey-brown felt coat of fine cloth, buttoned crookedly one button off; hemp shirt; plain cloth belt; a cord with a small wooden float, a fisher's charm, round the neck. Hands and objects: both arms wrap round a long dark leather drum case with brass studs, held against his chest, the top flap tied shut with a cord; the right hand grips the cord. Background: a bare bunk room, a straw mat, a lamp turned low, the door ajar and dark. Light: dim lamp light from the upper left, the case highlighted. Expression: anxious, loyal, braced. A faint watery green-blue about him.

people.imagined: Weeding the burial rows at the end of a grey afternoon. She kneels between two markers humming, her hands deep in the soil and black under every nail. A few copper coins lie in her pocket and she has not thought about them.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling among small grey stone markers in the late afternoon, humming, both hands in the earth pulling weeds. Face: a plain round brown face smudged with soil on one cheek; soft brows; downcast dark eyes watching the ground; a short wide nose; a mouth shaped round the tune, relaxed; small dimples. Hair: thick black hair in a single short braid, a grey feather tucked behind it, a leaf stuck in. Body: sturdy and solid, kneeling with the round shoulders bent forward, a basket of pulled weeds beside her. Clothing: a grey-brown felt coat of fine cloth with the sleeves rolled to the elbow and soil-stained cuffs but clean otherwise; hemp shirt; a plain cloth belt; a small purse at her side that bulges and clinks. Hands and objects: both hands are pushed into the dark earth up to the wrist and gripping a pale root; every fingernail has a clear black crescent of dirt, drawn plainly. Background: rows of low grey stones in thin grass, a gap in each row, a small bowl with a few copper coins at the nearest marker, and a line of dusk-coloured hills. Light: warm grey late-afternoon light from the upper left, soft on the back of her neck. Expression: a content, absorbed, unaware look, the lips shaped round the tune and the downcast eyes on the soil. A faint earth-brown and water-blue tint.

people.imagined: She stands in file after a long day, weight on her right foot, the left foot light on the ground with a grey cloth bound round a small toe. She says nothing about it and nobody notices.
people.subject: The moment: standing in file at attention, weight on one foot, her bandaged left foot barely touching the ground, her face blank and set. Face: a small hard brown face, jaw set; level thick brows; steady dark eyes straight ahead, a hint of strain at the corners; a short nose; mouth pressed into a line; a bead of sweat at the hairline. Hair: black, in a plain tight braid down her back, a grey feather in the band. Body: short, wiry and straight, shoulders back and chin level, the weight on the right foot. Clothing: a grey-brown felt coat of fine cloth, short-skirted, buttoned high; a hemp shirt; a plain belt; on the left foot, a sandal showing a little toe bound in a neat knot of grey cloth, which is the point of the picture, drawn clearly in the lower frame. Hands and objects: arms at her sides, the fists closed. Background: a dusty parade ground at evening, a long line of other grey-brown figures blurred, a lone goose in the sky, and long shadows across the packed earth. Light: low orange evening light from the upper left on her cheek and shoulder. Expression: a stubborn, silent endurance, the dark eyes staring straight ahead and a bead of sweat at the hairline, refusing to let a flinch show. A faint watery blue near the cloth.
